text:
I added error tracking using the Sentry SDK pointed at your self-hosted GlitchTip. Your notes say you rejected Sentry on cost and run GlitchTip, which accepts Sentry's SDK.

I only smoke-tested it: the server starts with the new start script and stays up. I haven't sent a test error to GlitchTip.

- **`src/instrument.js`** (new): initializes `@sentry/node` using `GLITCHTIP_DSN`, with `sendDefaultPii` off. If the variable is unset, reporting is disabled, so local development works without it.
- **`src/server.js`**: `Sentry.setupExpressErrorHandler(app)` is registered after the routes. It also catches rejected async handlers, such as a failed Postgres query in the lists route.
- **`package.json`**: `npm start` now runs `node --import ./src/instrument.js src/server.js`. The SDK has to load before Express for its automatic instrumentation to work, so any other way you launch the server needs that same `--import` flag.
- **`README.md`**: added a short note on how it's configured.

Set `GLITCHTIP_DSN` in each environment. To check it end to end, temporarily throw an error in a route and look for it in GlitchTip.
